The '''''Crucible''''' was a [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80 ''Liberty'' type]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The ''Crucible'' participated in the [[Attack on Soren|First Battle of Mobetta]], arriving after the battle had begun in an attempt to evacuate the crew of the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|starship components factory]] ''[[Soren]]''. All [[Starship/Legends|ships]] evacuating personnel to the ''Crucible'' were destroyed, however, and the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was forced to retreat when it became a target. The ''Crucible'' then launched two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] to cover its escape. While both squadrons were destroyed, they did buy the cruiser time to flee into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
